description: Functions and classes for working with UD scalar array.

functions.name: extra
functions.signature: itasca.data.scalararray.extra(slot: int) -> array float{scalar} or float{scalar}
functions.description: Get the scalar extra data in the given slot as an array. Extra variables accessed by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: ids
functions.description: Get the scalar ids as an array.

functions.name: in_group
functions.description: Return scalar group membership as a Boolean array.

functions.name: pos
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the current position of ud scalars.

functions.name: set_extra
functions.signature: itasca.data.scalararray.set_extra(slot: int, data: array float{scalar} or float{scalar}) -> None
functions.description: Set the scalar extra data in the given slot with an array. Extra variables set by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: set_group
functions.signature: itasca.data.scalararray.set_group(membership: array bool{scalar}, group_name: str, slot=1) -> None
functions.description: Set scalar group from an array. Where membership True set the corresponding scalar to be a member of group group_name in the given slot.

functions.name: set_pos
functions.description: Set the position of ud scalar array.

functions.name: set_value
functions.description: Set the values of ud scalars.

functions.name: value
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the current value of ud scalars.
